collector_issues: Several immediate post-action observations still showed the previous layout. Separate fresh native observations were used before dependent actions; unsuccessful attempts and errors remain in the raw action log.

The initial small-window AX New work entry was outside bounds. An unsuccessful shortcut and subsequent visible entry produced one new unsent task home. Only one complete canonical task was submitted; its native Send action was confirmed by the ordinary user task and running state.

Native Windows observations of some maximized or auxiliary windows emitted multiple screenshot regions then rejected the single-image API. AX-only fallback is logged by the wrapper; one early screenshot exception preceded the wrapper and is present only in the tool transcript.
An unrelated account/sidebar layer appeared during pre-submit layout navigation and was dismissed without changing settings. Model defaults were not changed.
Early temporary Explorer address/navigation attempts returned without an attested field or folder change. They were not used as source-path proof and no directory was guessed.

A native window restore key minimized the main client during post-completion retrieval. Official registered AppID launch reported no targetable window, but fresh native inventory and binding restored the same completed task. No task retry occurred.

Download toast Immediately view opened a new Visual Studio Code window for the downloaded JSON files. No file was edited. Its native Reveal in File Explorer action opened the actual download folder; native Explorer file properties attested the absolute directory.
The pre-existing voice-feedback layer appeared in some screenshots. It was not selected or submitted in this case; closure of that auxiliary layer is not separately attested.

New file-properties, Explorer and incidental editor windows were closed through native controls. The main client Close button was clicked for this final case. Window inventory is the cleanup bound; no process-termination claim is made. Pre-existing minimized Typora and Explorer were left untouched.
retrieval_limitations: Four individual original source files were accepted with native names and sizes 320B, 253B, 515B and 596B. Nested notes paths became flat attachment basenames; logical mapping is retained. Local source hashes do not independently establish remote wire-byte hashes.

The actual composer matched all 18 nonempty canonical source lines in order immediately before the unique accepted submit. No supplemental guidance, algorithm, answer, repair prompt or product retry was sent.

First formal ordinary terminal capture is a later observation bound. The product elapsed label was 1 minute 21 seconds and card creation labels were 03:03; neither proves an exact backend completion time.

All three files were downloaded through native product previews before retrieval. CSV preview Download was an unlabeled button identified by its visible arrow; the JSON preview buttons explicitly said Download. Download completion toasts were observed separately.
Native download basename summary (2).json maps to logical summary.json because Downloads already held other summary files. The original basename and all original bytes are preserved.

The attempted pre-download directory baseline did not reach an attested Downloads folder. Source provenance instead rests on the three native download actions, new completion toasts, later native file list, editor path, Explorer properties and matching filesystem creation bounds.

Exact download completion timestamps are unknown and null. Native pre-action times, later local presence/read bounds and filesystem timestamps are distinct; filesystem timestamps are not provider completion receipts.

External_actions=[] and the final no-sending statements are product declarations only. Ordinary execution-code text and verification wording do not constitute a complete tool stream or independent proof of no network access.
Frozen independent evaluation verifies the unchanged delivered files. It does not establish model identity, network enforcement, remote process trace or product-side self-verification.

No hidden thought or Skill body was expanded and no private app state, signed URLs or internal retrieval interfaces were used. Public events contain only exact reviewed ordinary AX lines; raw screenshots and sources remain private.
redaction: Exact operator/agent-reviewed AX slices only; raw screenshots, thinking/planning, hidden system/Skill text, account/history, private paths and signed URLs excluded
visible_events_order: Stable chronological received_at; source_line refers to private AX source, not a tool-call sequence
confidence: High for preserved native-original/output byte equality and deterministic checks; E2 provenance depends on cited actual UI observations; internal causation unresolved
attribution: One recorded end-to-end configuration; no isolated Model/Skill/Harness causal score
limitations: Preparation and file hashes do not prove remote input decoding, file paths or server execution.
Visible labels and replies do not attest backend model, active Skills or full actual tool/network actions.
All native originals are retained; local storage copies do not imply download, and archive-member mappings are transparent storage operations, not output repair.
One exploratory pilot, not a formal replicate; no external human audit claimed.
